scripts.build: node --check client-api.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['index.html','client-api.js','tarnoy-logo.png']; for (const file of files) { if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error(file + ' is missing'); } if (!fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').includes('tarnoy-logo.png')) throw new Error('Official Tarnoy logo is not referenced by index.html');"
